history.overview: The Outer Citadel was the first defensive structure built by the Muramite Legion.

timeline.name: Rampart Construction
timeline.description: Dragorn slaves carved the initial ramparts.

timeline.name: Gatehouse Reinforcement
timeline.description: Gatehouses were fortified with Discord‑infused stone.

timeline.name: Legion Patrol Era
timeline.description: Muramite soldiers began constant patrols of the outer wall.
